# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-27 from the 2026-10-27 Hub dump.

- 3,188,478 models tracked, 907,759 declare a base model, 940,738 parent links, 89,459 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
